findings.claim: The supplied review material must expose enough of the task-owned implementation and focused test changes to evaluate the lifecycle semantics goal.
findings.observed: The caller-computed diff visibility contract is complete=false and explicitly omits be-document-processing/src/document_processing/audit/audit_lifecycle_observations.py and be-document-processing/tests/test_monitor_lifecycle_observations.py; only unrelated included paths and a partial OpenAPI path are visible. The supplied RED/GREEN proof demonstrates the focused command outcome but does not expose the delivered reducer and test semantics for review.
findings.rationale: Because both exact task-owned paths are omitted, semantic acceptance cannot establish whether canonical attempt identity, terminal reconciliation, ambiguity, scope, availability, and bounded-window behavior satisfy the contract. Omission proves only incomplete visibility, not missing or incorrect implementation.
findings.required: Provide a complete task-scoped diff or equivalent caller-supplied review artifact covering the owned reducer and focused test paths, then perform semantic acceptance against that material.
